name: email
description: What an email can state: what was sent or proposed, prices, the meetings it plans and promises. Status is never extracted. Version 2 replaced deal.meeting_proposed (a date per proposal) with meeting_plan items; facts version 1 wrote still read.

deal.description: A sales opportunity, by its CRM id.

action_taken.description: something the sender says they did

attachment_sent.description: the name of a file attached

price_quoted.description: a price stated in the email

requirement.description: a capability the prospect asks for

title.description: job title, e.g. from a signature

rep.description: One of our people, by email.

commitment.description: Something promised in the email. An item: commitment:<episode>#<n>.

owner.description: who promised it, by id: rep:<email> for one of ours, contact:<email> for someone at the prospect

meeting_plan.description: A meeting this email itself proposes, accepts, moves or cancels; never one only in quoted or forwarded history. An item: meeting_plan:<episode>#<n>, one per meeting. Whether it is agreed is not extracted: aggregation works it out across the thread, so a later acceptance settles earlier proposals.

step.description: what this email does about the meeting and when, e.g. 'proposes Tue or Wed afternoon', 'accepts Thu 3pm CT', 'cancels Friday's demo'

starts_at.description: when the meeting would start, one fact per time this email names for it
